The '''Figg Daily Bulletin''' was a [[Media/Legends|media]] news outlet<ref name="SWI" /> that shared its name with [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], founder of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|location|cloudcity|Cloud City}}</ref> At some point before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Occupation of Bespin]]<ref name="SWI" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Duncan Hikmat]], who served in the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] in that [[Time/Legends|time]], was featured in the Figg Daily Bulletin and ''[[Action Tidings]]''<ref name="SWI" />&mdash;the latter being a news station local to Bespin<ref name="Action">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespin1|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 1: Live From the Surface}}</ref>&mdash;for apprehending a group of [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] art [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="SWI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Figg Daily Bulletin was mentioned in the article "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards]]," published in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 148|148th issue]]<ref name="SWI" /> on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref>
